text:
sam_partnerships: Heads-up: quick kickoff for ToolX + LangChain gateway hookup in 30m. Short goal: confirm auth flow and one-pass demo.

leila_eng: I'll join. Do we have an auth diagram? OIDC? API key?

sam_partnerships: ToolX prefers OIDC; we've asked for a test tenant. For now we'll support API key fallback.

aj_dev: Noted. If it's OIDC we'll need a clientcred flow example and a token cache. I can sketch a patch.

nate_sdk: SDK note: our connector needs to expose an async `send_tool_call` to match LangChain agent loop. Will push a tiny shim to packages/toolx-connector today.

olivia_marketing: Quick Q: any embargo on announcing the integration? ToolX legal flagged a soft embargo until final security checklist. We should avoid public blog copy for now.

sam_partnerships: Good call. Hold public comms until security signoff. We'll do a beta-only joint note.

karen_docs: Docs: I'll draft a quickstart with examples for both API key and OIDC flows. Need example payloads and model route names.

aj_dev: Example model route for connector: `toolx-langchain-compat-v1` — maps to `redwood-open-7b` in staging. Also sample payload:```
{"tool": "search", "query": "find docs about adapters", "context": []}```

nate_sdk: Pushed beta tag: `npm i @redwood/toolx-connector@beta.1`. Test harness URL: https://ci.redwood.internal/toolx-harness/1768019999

ci_bot: CI pipeline kicked: toolx-connector-beta #58 (tests: unit, smoke).

leila_eng: On perf — what's our target tail latency for the agent loop? ToolX said they can accept up to 300ms per token for interactive demos, but for production they'd like <120ms.

aj_dev: We should add a cache layer for llm context to keep loop latency low. I'll prototype a local KV cache in runtime.

sam_partnerships: Next steps: 1) eng to finalize auth + cache prototype (aj, leila). 2) SDK beta + quickstart (nate, karen). 3) Marketing hold until security OK (olivia). 4) schedule partner dry-run next Tue.

olivia_marketing: I'll draft internal announcement and a partner one-pager for legal review.

karen_docs: Putting quickstart PR up: https://git.redwood.com/docs/toolx-quickstart/pull/12

aj_dev: If anyone wants to run the end-to-end locally, use this env stub:```
export TOOLX_API_KEY=local_test_key
export REDWOOD_STAGING=https://staging.redwood.internal
node examples/run-agent.js --connector=@redwood/toolx-connector@beta.1```

sam_partnerships: Recording: https://meetings.redwood/rec/1768019999 (will upload notes). Thanks team — we'll sync after the dry-run.

ci_bot: All checks passed for beta #58. Artifacts: toolx-connector-beta-58.tgz
